purpose: Outcome-blind rematerialization of scientifically valid live-observable 2CQ cross-sectional choices, linked to but not gated by a strict forensic Tier-A subset.

population.development: first 350 V2-online-eligible decisions in canonical chronology from the unchanged prospective start
population.validation: next 150 V2-online-eligible decisions, sealed until one primary policy is frozen
population.dedupe: independent 2CQ entry episode under the existing finalized wallet acquisition semantics

onlineChoice.teacherAction: canonical finalized successful independent acquisition observed prospectively by the AllenHark capture-first detector
onlineChoice.boundary: capture-first AllenHark local receipt time of the exact teacher action
onlineChoice.selectedActionCompactDuplicateRationale: the teacher action establishes the boundary but is not a pre-action feature; duplicate compact-observer presence is retained as forensic evidence

forensicTierA.purpose: audit reconstruction error, realtime missingness, route coverage, and strict evidence completeness
